description:
New Zealand provisional tax and terminal tax due dates.

    Use for: 'provisional tax dates 2027', 'provisional tax payment dates', 'when
    is provisional tax due', 'terminal tax date', 'ratio option dates'.

    31 MARCH BALANCE DATE: 28 August, 15 January and 7 May (standard or estimation);
    28 October and 7 May for six-monthly GST filers; 28 June, 28 August, 28 October,
    15 January, 28 February and 7 May for the ratio option. Terminal tax 7 February,
    or 7 April with a tax agent. A weekend or public holiday date moves to the next
    working day.

    Args:
        balance_month: Balance date month, 1 to 12 (3 for 31 March).
        balance_year: Year the balance date falls in. Omitted, the next one.
        option: standard, six_monthly_gst or ratio.
        tax_agent: True for a tax agent's extension of time.

    Returns:
        Each instalment and terminal tax date, before and after any move.
name: nz_provisional_tax_dates_calculator
